name: banking_support
setting: the online chat of a retail bank
instruction: Which banking team should handle this customer?

options.cards: card services: card payments, card limits, blocking cards, pending or disputed card charges
options.fraud: fraud team: money taken without the customer's consent, scams, stolen credentials
options.loans: loans and mortgages: repayments, rates and changes to an existing loan
options.accounts: account services: opening and closing accounts, statements, transfers
options.complaints: formal complaints: fee disputes where the customer wants compensation

issue.description: what kind of problem it is
issue.question: Could you tell me what exactly went wrong?

product.description: which product the issue is about
product.question: Which of your products is this about: a card, a current account, a loan or a savings account?

money_gone.description: whether money has already left the customer's account
money_gone.question: Has any money already left your account?

compensation.description: whether the customer is asking for money back as compensation
compensation.question: Are you asking us to compensate you for this?

customer_name.question: May I have your first name, please?
